mechanism: Agents MARK a shared environment with structured {{trace}}s instead of sending direct messages. Other agents SENSE traces and respond. Coordination emerges from accumulated trace patterns without any agent-to-agent communication. Persistence is either {{decay}} with reinforcement, or versioning — the scheme is declared, not assumed.
gloss: Indirect coordination via environment modification (Ant Colony)
invariants: Persistence scheme is declared: either {{decay}} with reinforcement, or versioning.
Locality: sensing is local to the agent's position.
No direct channel: coordination passes through the environment, never agent to agent.
failure_modes: Trace pollution: too many traces, and the signal is lost among them.
Namespace collision: unrelated agents mark the same medium and read each other's traces as their own.
Semantic ambiguity: agents interpret the same trace differently.
Persistence mismatch: traces fade before they coordinate, or persist after they mislead.
Unattributable trace: a mark cannot be tied to whoever left it.
